say:2:1826043001:1.source_cn: 月弯街还是这么繁华又喧闹。

say:3:1826043002:1.text: I heard this is where the explosion that injured Grezhul took place. It must've done a great deal of damage, wouldn't you say?
say:3:1826043002:1.source_cn: 听闻前阵子街上发生了爆炸，连我们的禁卫军长官格瑞泽尔勒...

say:4:1826043003:1.text: So, where do things stand now? Has the cause of the explosion been identified?
say:4:1826043003:1.source_cn: 现在情况如何？事故原因的调查结果有了吗？

say:5:1826043004:1.text: Forgive me, but I'm not involved in the investigation, so I don't have much to share.
say:5:1826043004:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我并不负责相关事务，因此不清楚。

say:6:1826043005:1.text: It surprises me that Lady Tephesia sent a small fry like you to receive me. Is this her idea of hospitality?
say:6:1826043005:1.source_cn: 连这种小事都不清楚，苔佩希小姐却派你来招待，该不会是想...

say:7:1826043006:1.text: It isn't my place to speculate about Her Ladyship's intentions.
say:7:1826043006:1.source_cn: 我不敢随意揣度领主阁下的用意。

say:8:1826043007:1.text: No need to be so tense, loyal little bat.
say:8:1826043007:1.source_cn: 别紧张，忠心耿耿的蝙蝠。

say:9:1826043008:1.text: Surely you know where the explosion happened, at least?
say:9:1826043008:1.source_cn: 那么，你至少知道发生爆炸的事故地点吧？

say:10:1826043009:1.text: Take me there. Perhaps I could offer just the assistance Lady Tephesia needs.
say:10:1826043009:1.source_cn: 带我过去，说不定我能为苔佩希小姐排忧解难。

say:11:1826043010:1.text: I'm afraid I can't oblige. You're a distinguished guest, and Her Ladyship made it clear that we mustn't impose upon you.
say:11:1826043010:1.source_cn: 很抱歉，我不能这么做。领主阁下嘱咐过，您是骸骨之王派来...

say:12:1826043011:1.text: Oh... she seems to have covered a lot of ground with you lot.
say:12:1826043011:1.source_cn: 哦……原来她还嘱咐了这么多啊。

say:13:1826043012:0.text: Fine, I shall dispense with the visit to the <style="highlight">Adamant Syndicate branch</style>, then. L<u><link=Case><style=highlight>ady Tephesia is one of its Seven Elders</style></link></u>, after all. I'm sure she'll handle the matter appropriately.

say:15:1826043014:1.text: Heh, I rather like that wide-eyed expression on your face. A touch of fear would make it perfect.
say:15:1826043014:1.source_cn: 呵呵，我喜欢你这副惊讶的表情，若是再多些畏惧就更好了。

say:16:1826043015:1.text: As long as Novaris remains part of Bantus, nothing goes unnoticed by the Fallen King. Don't you forget that.
say:16:1826043015:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯是班题斯的领土，没有任何事能瞒过骸骨之王——牢牢...

say:18:1826043017:1.text: By the way, I was told that Senea, the legendary Lightbearer star, has lived in Novaris since her death. I'd very much like to meet her. The Seasong Theater isn't on Lady Tephesia's list of restricted locations, I hope?
say:18:1826043017:1.source_cn: 听闻耀光的传奇女星塞涅死后一直生活于诺珐斯，我想见她一...

say:19:1826043018:1.text: The theater has no shows today, so there's no guarantee you'll get to see Miss Senea.
say:19:1826043018:1.source_cn: 今日海歌剧院没有演出，您未必能见到塞涅小姐。

say:20:1826043019:1.text: Well, there's only one way to find out. Miss Senea and I might find ourselves kindred spirits.
say:20:1826043019:1.source_cn: 总要试试才知道。说不定，我和塞涅小姐会一见如故。

say:21:1826043020:1.text: Or... would you rather take me to the Syndicate building instead?
say:21:1826043020:1.source_cn: 还是说，比起海歌剧院，你宁可我去黑金商会的废墟上看看？

say:23:1826043022:1.text: The <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style> lies east of Crescent Street. This way, please.
